description: This PHP class, ConfirmationController, extends AbstractInstallerVueController and manages the confirmation screen in the installer module of OrangeHRM. It initializes a Vue component for confirmation and sets the current installer screen state.

classes.name: ConfirmationController
classes.description: Controller managing the confirmation screen of the installer process, responsible for rendering the component and updating the installer state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by creating the confirmation Vue component and updating the installer state to the confirmation screen.
